normalized.summary: Built a local Metaweb recovery specimen that generates a PDF with visible reconstruction instructions plus a machine-readable JSON manifest and a deliberately corrupted sidecar for checksum comparison testing. The script runs successfully and produces five outputs each run.
normalized.positive_assertion: The script successfully reads the provided EPUB payload, derives a recovery manifest from its real bytes, emits a PDF with visible instructions, and produces both a valid and a corrupted manifest so checksum-difference handling can be verified locally.
normalized.negative_assertion: This is not a true PDF/A-3 with embedded associated-file metadata, and it does not attempt to reconstruct the original site or extract the EPUB contents into a full recovery package.
normalized.limitations: Visible PDF text and JSON sidecars are implemented; standards-complete PDF/A-3 attachment metadata, semantic PDF/A validation, and automatic extraction of an embedded file from the PDF itself are not implemented in this specimen.

meaning: Read-only check of the actual failed SDK submission. Path normalization succeeds; PDF mechanism correctness is NOT certified and no agent code was executed.
